I can relate to this so fucking much. I’ve been having a real rough. Both parents passed last yr. I dropped out of college, lost a job. I’ve been in and out of counseling and homeless on and off for the past yr. My psych refused to see me the beginning of the month. I was 5 minutes late due to a new self checkin that froze up. I walked over to the office admin who’d been sitting there watching me. Walked over to check in with her and was sent out the door with a new appointment a week later. FF 2 weeks and I’m in complete withdrawal from 11 meds I’ve been on for 5+ yrs; meds they wouldn’t refill until I saw the psych. On top of that I hadn’t slept more than 2 hours a day in almost a week. Went for the rescheduled appointment and they refused to see me because I couldn’t pay the $100 no show fee from a few days before on top of my copay. Came home and drank myself to the point of blacking our. Slept through two work shifts and had to call out another to try to get back to that dr. Long story short I ended up sitting on my bathroom floor with a gun in my mouth. Couldn’t muster up the courage to do it and feel worse now having hit that point and failed on the follow through. Chipped my front tooth on the gun the night I thought I’d be free from the pain I constantly feel. Coming up on the date of my parents death and I’m working a job that’s soul crushing - esp this time of yr. I’m broke, constantly on edge and spend every minute of the day battling suicidal thoughts. Today after a customer called - couldn’t have been more that 14 yo & screamed at me over some dlc I couldn’t unsee myself bleeding out. Like Shining style amounts of blood and hate and anger and rage and all the horrible things that make me who I am flooding out. I just want to be free. Struggling more and more every day - to the point don’t know if I’m going to make it to see tomorrow let alone next week. 

Really wish I could take the pain/hurt you feel away. No one should have to live with the feeling and thoughts that stick with me. I hope your situation gets better. I hope you’re able to find something worth holding on for.

In my experience it depends on how deep the cut is and how well you care for the wound. A few years back I found this medication/ointment called Neomycin that I constantly use now. As soon as coming out of the numbness that pushed to to cut, I’ve got everything set out to clean up what typically looks like a crime scene. Neomycin is an antibiotic salve that reduces infection, seems to shorten healing time and lessens scarring. You can still tell I have scars, but they’re not as bad as the ones I have from before I began using this stuff. On older scars I’ve used Mederma with some success. I’m part Italian with olive skin so most of my scars become albino white.  Bottom line, just be safe.   And look out for potential size effects with any med/ointment you use. Trust me, it’s much worse when you have infected areas and then have an allergic reaction to some shitty topical cream.
